findings.claim: Hermes plugin conversation and title metadata are orphaned.
findings.evidence: Exact HEAD consumes petdex_conversation_key and petdex_session_title in hook_runner.zig and the built artifact emitted both.
findings.path: Hermes plugin -> hook_runner -> hook server mailbox

findings.claim: Hermes cards cannot seed or receive titles.
findings.evidence: pre_llm_call user_message seeds the title cache and state.db titles override it through petdex_session_title.

findings.claim: Missing state.db suppresses all primary events.
findings.evidence: The missing-DB oracle returns kind primary for non-forced events and the plugin emits them.
findings.path: sqlite mode=ro failure -> primary fallback -> emit

findings.claim: Assistant, approval, and subagent phases are no-ops.
findings.evidence: Each phase now has a bubble, state, busy disposition, regression test, and real built-binary HTTP emission.

findings.claim: Rollback can truncate an unreadable existing file.
findings.evidence: Snapshots carry a validity bit and mutation refuses to start unless every existing file was captured.

findings.claim: Uninstall can partially rewrite configuration or delete a user-modified plugin.
findings.evidence: Uninstall snapshots all four files, restores on writer failure, and refuses deletion when plugin bytes differ.

findings.claim: Gateway and null-child subagent identities can split or collide cards.
findings.evidence: Gateway keys hash before truncation and lifecycle events fall back through the persisted parent when child_session_id is absent.
findings.path: Hermes session key or parent -> _conversation_key -> payloadSessionId -> mailbox

exemptions.evidence: Its Hermes mention is a portfolio entry for the separate Hermes Agent project and states no Petdex hook behavior.

exemptions.claim: The shellmeta findings do not apply to this diff.
exemptions.evidence: The flagged detectors are unchanged from the merge base and Hermes executes a fixed exact command with shell=false.

exemptions.claim: Hermes remains unavailable on Windows in v1.
exemptions.evidence: Official Hermes shell-hook execution uses POSIX shlex semantics; scan and install explicitly skip Windows while the full Petdex Windows build still passes.
